note: identical: this check's only initial condition is an integer label field, and there is no sub-quantum perturbation of one. The smallest change it can store is a whole pixel, which is a change of topology rather than of value: it moves the object boundary the diffusion integrates against. That was measured rather than assumed - removing one rim pixel moved the flow field by 1.0, the full scale of a flow component, and changed the foreground set so the trajectory array's own shape moved. A bound wide enough to admit that would admit any fault, so the variant is an identical copy and the bound below is justified from the floor instead, which is 0.0 exactly across repeated runs.
